theorem ext_vanishing_equivalence
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherian R R]
  (I : Ideal R)
  (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [IsNoetherian R M]
  (hM_nontrivial : Nontrivial M)
  (hIM_proper : I • M < ⊤ : Submodule R M)
  (n : ℕ) :
  (∀ (N : Type*) [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [IsNoetherian R N],
    Nontrivial N →
    (∀ p : Ideal R, Ideal.IsPrime p → p ∈ Ideal.vanishingLocus I → p ∈ Submodule.annihilator N) →
    ∀ i < n, Module.Ext R i N M = 0) ↔
  (∀ i < n, Module.Ext R i (R ⧸ I) M = 0) ↔
  (∃ (N : Type*) [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [IsNoetherian R N],
    Nontrivial N ∧
    (∀ p : Ideal R, Ideal.IsPrime p →
      (p ∈ Submodule.annihilator N ↔ p ∈ Ideal.vanishingLocus I)) ∧
    ∀ i < n, Module.Ext R i N M = 0) ↔
  ∃ (s : List R), s.length = n ∧
    (∀ a ∈ s, a ∈ I) ∧
    ∀ i < s.length, IsRegular M (s.get ⟨i, by omega⟩) := sorry
